contracts.blurb: Plan a state bond for roads and water, with every naira tracked.
Look after members' savings slowly and safely.
Raise money for a new rice mill from honest investors.
Roadshows for pension funds that want African bonds.
Advise on joining two trading groups, kept quiet until announced.
A dual listing in Lagos and New York on the same day.

belt.name: File Trolley Runner
belt.blurb: A clerk with a brass trolley moves client files from the lounge to the analyst desks.

auto.name: Deal Tube System
auto.blurb: Clear tubes shoot finished documents from every desk to the deal room.

pack.name: Digital Deal Vault
pack.blurb: A secure online data room: files arrive, get checked and are delivered with no carrying.

milestones.title: Second Office
milestones.blurb: Abeokuta opens for state clients. Same kolanut crown on the door.

milestones.title: Five Offices
milestones.blurb: Traders and boards across the South West know the name.

milestones.title: Abuja Desk
milestones.blurb: An office near the regulator. Clean paperwork, fast approvals.

milestones.title: Every Region
milestones.blurb: Offices in the North, East and South-South, each with its own deal team.

milestones.title: Market Gate Clinic
milestones.blurb: A free business clinic opens at the market gate where it all began.

milestones.title: London and Dubai
milestones.blurb: Roadshows abroad bring new investors to African companies.

milestones.title: New York Bell
milestones.blurb: A dual listing rings bells in Lagos and New York on one day.

milestones.title: Dealmaker of the Year
milestones.blurb: The pepper seller's daughter lifts the trophy. Mama Sikira is in the front row.

staff: Data room is locked. Only the deal team goes in.
Printer jammed again! Nobody leave files on it.
Client signed. Ring the small bell!
customer: I need my business registered properly.
Can you help me find honest investors?
Our family company wants to list.
The state needs a bond for a bridge.
We want to join with our rival, fairly.
How long will the regulator take?
Please explain the fee to me plainly.
My accounts are in this shoebox.

manager: Every filing went out clean this week.
The team is stretched. One more analyst would help.
Market mood is shy this week. Maybe price a little lower.
Capital is above the licence line.
The data room log is clean.
Bonus season is coming. The team is watching.
night: A deal you cannot explain to your mother is a deal you should not sign.
One desk, one umbrella. Look at us now.
Savings are people's retirement. Slow and safe.
Mama, I ate. The deal can wait till morning.

events.name: Oversubscribed!
events.text: Investors want twice what is on offer. A big day in the lounge.

events.name: Market Wobble
events.text: Share prices dip and investors turn shy. Order books fill slower today.

events.name: Referral From Mama
events.text: Mama Sikira sends five traders with their shoeboxes. More clients today.

events.name: Leak Scare
events.text: A merger file was left on the printer. The team locks it up fast and checks the data room. Extra security costs today.

events.name: Deal of the Year
events.text: A finance magazine praises your bond. A partner firm sends a thank-you gift.

events.name: Generator Wahala
events.text: Power cuts out at deadline. Files reach the desks slowly today.

events.name: Rates Come Down
events.text: Interest rates ease. Companies and states want to raise money. Fees are up today.

events.name: Fresh Interns
events.text: Three eager graduates join for the week. Desks move faster.

mech.name: Hand carry

mech.how: Okada rider with a locked document box runs files between offices

mech.how: Clear ceiling tubes whoosh gold capsules from every desk to the deal room
